name: yalla
description: Yalla: a mobile-first campus social app. Live friends map, hangouts, group chat, clubs. PWA on Supabase with database-enforced privacy. 303 automated tests.

paragraphs: A mobile-first social app for university students: see where your friends are on a live campus map, start or join a hangout, chat in the group, and follow clubs. Privacy comes first: everyone starts in ghost mode, and your location is only ever visible to mutual friends you chose.
Built for the Al Akhawayn University community in Ifrane, Morocco. It installs on a phone like an app (iPhone and Android) and runs on a free stack.

whatItDoes.text: A mobile-first social app for university students: see where your friends are on a live campus map, start or join a hangout, chat in the group, and follow clubs. Privacy comes first: everyone starts in ghost mode, and your location is only ever visible to mutual friends you chose.

audience.text: Built for the Al Akhawayn University community in Ifrane, Morocco. It installs on a phone like an app (iPhone and Android) and runs on a free stack.

requirements.text: Live campus map with friends, hangouts and the scratch map Hangouts, with "Picked for you" and the reasons why Route and ETA to a friend A hangout: who is going, why it suits you Group chat with stickers Besties, most hung out with, clubs Ranks and the Butterfly badge Starting a hangout Live location: 1, 4 or 8 hours, then it stops Ghost mode: nobody sees you Profile, badge…
supabase/tests/dev-stack.sh: a local test backend (Postgres, PostgREST and a small fake of the login and storage services) so the real UI can be driven in a browser without any account.
